currentConditionsResolver.Condition: Base article / lunation article / node-axis article / LilithArticle
currentConditionsResolver.Resolver rule: Resolve canonical editorial content key first.
currentConditionsResolver.De-duplication rule: Contextual overlays and current conditions may not restate the base thesis as a second intro.
currentConditionsResolver.Hard stop: Missing optional condition does not blank base article.

currentConditionsResolver.Resolver rule: Resolve by latitude: north / south / neutral.
currentConditionsResolver.De-duplication rule: Do not repeat sign thesis already in article; seasonal copy is light-cycle context only.
currentConditionsResolver.Hard stop: Never serve Northern-Hemisphere season language universally.

currentConditionsResolver.Resolver rule: Resolve through ContextualOverlayResolver after the base article and before motion/aspect sections.
currentConditionsResolver.De-duplication rule: Exact reviewed overlay only. Apply event/aspect suppression metadata. Max 2 full-page; fallback max 1 and only when Content Studio toggle is ON.
currentConditionsResolver.Hard stop: No runtime synthesis. Parent overlay setting OFF = omit. Fallback hook toggle never modifies stored Hook text.

currentConditionsResolver.Reader role: Replaces ordinary New/Full Moon main body
currentConditionsResolver.Resolver rule: When eventType is solar-eclipse or lunar-eclipse, render event-specific eclipse article as lunationArticle.
currentConditionsResolver.De-duplication rule: Ordinary New/Full Moon sign article may supply cycle memory, not a duplicate primary article.
currentConditionsResolver.Hard stop: Do not create eclipse copy by adding 'intense' to ordinary Moon copy.

currentConditionsResolver.Resolver rule: Resolve nodeAxisContentKey + North/South relation before eclipse modifier.
currentConditionsResolver.De-duplication rule: If event article already carries an exact node-series phrase, do not append generic hunger/release sentence that says the same thing.
currentConditionsResolver.Hard stop: No eclipse node interpretation without calculated node relation.

currentConditionsResolver.Resolver rule: Sign-specific approved copy → planet/body generic modifier → absent.
currentConditionsResolver.De-duplication rule: Do not repeat a sign-return chapter inside generic modifier. Cross-sign retrogrades render the chapter matching current sign.
currentConditionsResolver.Source authority: RetrogradeModifiers + governed sign-specific records + website audit

currentConditionsResolver.Resolver rule: Continuous pages: approved aspects involving the page subject body only. Lunations/eclipses: direct Sun/Moon aspects plus explicit eventContextAspectIds. Nodes/Lilith: only reviewed supported aspects to those points.
currentConditionsResolver.De-duplication rule: Direct subject/luminary aspects render before curated event-context aspects. If an overlay duplicates an exact aspect mechanism and suppression metadata says aspect wins, omit the overlay rather than rewriting either block.
currentConditionsResolver.Source authority: AspectSectionContract + reviewed Marie event aspect copy + approved aspect corpus
currentConditionsResolver.Hard stop: Do not render unrelated active sky aspects merely because they are active that day. Unsupported aspect = omit.

currentConditionsResolver.Resolver rule: Full article → exact family-specific fallback. For eclipses: exact event → sign-aware type+node+sign → generic type+node → facts-only.
currentConditionsResolver.De-duplication rule: If Content Studio fallback-overlay toggle is ON, insert only the highest-priority eligible reviewed fallbackHookOverlay after Hook; otherwise keep Hook → Lived → Turn.
currentConditionsResolver.Source authority: EclipseFallbackResolver + ContextualOverlayResolver + governed family fallback corpus
currentConditionsResolver.Hard stop: Any generated contextual bridge, mismatched node relation, or overlay that changes stored fallback Hook text is a hard stop.

aspectSectionContract.What qualifies: Only approved active aspects where the page subject body is one of the aspect participants.
aspectSectionContract.Selection order: Direct subject aspects only; sort by exactDateTime, then orb. If multiple become exact same day, preserve deterministic body/aspect order.
aspectSectionContract.Copy authority: Exact event/Marie aspect override when reviewed → approved aspect corpus
aspectSectionContract.Relationship to base article: Base article explains the transit in the sign. Aspect section explains what is modifying that transit now.
aspectSectionContract.Hard stop: Do not show unrelated sky aspects just because they are active on the same day.

aspectSectionContract.What qualifies: Approved aspects directly involving the Sun or Moon at/around the lunation, plus eventContextAspectIds explicitly attached to this lunation by the event registry.
aspectSectionContract.Selection order: Direct Sun/Moon aspects first; then explicitly curated event-context aspects; each group by exactDateTime/orb.
aspectSectionContract.Copy authority: Reviewed Marie lunation-specific aspect copy/headline → approved aspect corpus
aspectSectionContract.Relationship to base article: Evergreen NewMoonArticle/FullMoonArticle stays sign/axis based. Dated aspects never get baked into the evergreen article.
aspectSectionContract.Hard stop: Do not pull every active sky aspect into the lunation page.

aspectSectionContract.What qualifies: Same lunation rule: direct Sun/Moon eclipse aspects + explicitly curated event-context aspects.
aspectSectionContract.Selection order: Direct eclipse/luminary aspects first; event-context aspects second; exact time/orb within group.
aspectSectionContract.Copy authority: Reviewed Marie eclipse-specific aspect section → approved aspect corpus
aspectSectionContract.Relationship to base article: Eclipse article owns eclipse/axis/series story. Node relation is its own layer, not an aspect. Retrogrades/stations are separate current conditions.
aspectSectionContract.Hard stop: Do not duplicate the same exact Marie aspect paragraph inside EventArticle and Key aspects.

aspectSectionContract.What qualifies: Only if the product supports reviewed aspects to the calculated node points; otherwise no aspect section.
aspectSectionContract.Selection order: Exact aspects only, deterministic date/orb order.
aspectSectionContract.Relationship to base article: NodeAxisArticle remains the main axis story.
aspectSectionContract.Hard stop: Do not invent node aspect interpretations.

aspectSectionContract.What qualifies: Only reviewed aspects where Black Moon Lilith is a participant and the calculation mode supports the point/aspect.
aspectSectionContract.Relationship to base article: LilithArticle stays sign-specific; station remains separate Current Condition.

contextualOverlayResolver.Required match: Subject family/body/sign/condition + context kind/body/event/sign/condition all match active runtime facts
contextualOverlayResolver.Selection: Choose exact record(s) by ascending Priority. Max 2 full-page by Content Studio setting.
contextualOverlayResolver.Full-page render: Render OverlayBody inline after base article, no heading.
contextualOverlayResolver.Fallback-hook render: If `includeContextualOverlayInFallbackHook=true`, choose highest-priority matched record with FallbackHookEligible=true and render FallbackHookOverlay after Hook.
contextualOverlayResolver.Suppression: Apply exact-aspect duplicate and exact-event article suppression flags first.
contextualOverlayResolver.Hard stop: Never partially match a row by sign keywords or body category.

contextualOverlayResolver.Required match: No exact row; future approved family row explicitly matches subject/context family
contextualOverlayResolver.Selection: Use only if governance marks family overlay approved for that interaction.

contextualOverlayResolver.Full-page render: Base article flows directly to motion/other conditions.
contextualOverlayResolver.Hard stop: Never generate contextual synthesis at runtime.

contentStudioOverlaySettings.Applies to: continuous transit, lunation, eclipse, node, Lilith
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Enabled when: At least one reviewed overlay resolves for the current preview/event context
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Runtime effect: If OFF, omit ContextualTransitOverlay layer entirely. If ON, resolve exact reviewed overlay(s) after base article and before motion/aspect sections.
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Preview behavior: Preview shows overlay block and source/provenance badge.
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Hard rule: OFF never removes the base article, motion conditions, or aspects.

contentStudioOverlaySettings.UI Label: Include transit context in fallback hook
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Applies to: any family with Hook/Lived/Turn fallback and an eligible reviewed overlay
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Enabled when: `contextualTransitOverlaysEnabled=true` AND at least one resolved overlay has `FallbackHookEligible=true`
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Runtime effect: If OFF: fallback = Hook → Lived → Turn. If ON: Hook → highest-priority eligible `FallbackHookOverlay` → Lived → Turn.
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Preview behavior: Preview must show both OFF and ON states without rewriting either block.
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Hard rule: Maximum 1 overlay in fallback hook. Exact text only. No generated bridge sentence.

contentStudioOverlaySettings.UI Label: Maximum contextual overlays on full page
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Runtime effect: Render up to N reviewed overlays in priority order after suppression/de-dup rules.
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Preview behavior: Preview warns when additional matched overlays are suppressed by limit.
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Hard rule: Do not concatenate suppressed overlays into one generated summary.

contentStudioOverlaySettings.Runtime effect: Base article → contextual overlay(s) → motion/other conditions → aspects.

contentStudioOverlaySettings.UI Label: Suppress overlay when exact aspect owns same mechanism
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Enabled when: Resolved overlay metadata or editorial duplicate map identifies same mechanism
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Runtime effect: Exact aspect block wins for the exact interval; overlay omitted.
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Hard rule: Runtime may not paraphrase the overlay or aspect to keep both.

contentStudioOverlaySettings.UI Label: Suppress overlay when exact event article already says it
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Enabled when: Exact event article is present and duplicate mechanism is flagged
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Runtime effect: Exact event article wins; overlay omitted.
contentStudioOverlaySettings.Hard rule: Fallback can still use an eligible overlay when the exact event article is absent and the fallback toggle is ON.

contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Requirement: Content Studio must expose a toggle labeled `Use contextual transit overlays`.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.UI behavior: Toggle available at project/surface level. OFF hides the child fallback toggle and disables overlay selection.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Preview behavior: Preview immediately removes/restores resolved overlays without changing the base copy.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Hard stop: Must not disable aspects, retrogrades, stations, cycle context, or base article.

contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Requirement: Expose child toggle labeled `Include transit context in fallback hook`.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.UI behavior: Enabled only when parent toggle is ON and a matched overlay has FallbackHookEligible=true.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Preview behavior: Studio shows OFF preview and ON preview side by side or instantly toggleable.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Runtime output: OFF: Hook → Lived → Turn. ON: Hook → one exact fallbackHookOverlay → Lived → Turn.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Hard stop: Never rewrite or overwrite stored Hook text.

contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Requirement: Show resolved reviewed overlays for the preview event/context.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.UI behavior: Allow editor to deselect a reviewed overlay; do not allow freeform runtime-generated overlay creation in this control.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Preview behavior: Show source URL, trigger fields, priority, and suppression reason.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Runtime output: Only selected/resolved reviewed overlay keys may serve.

contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Requirement: Limit contextual overlays on one reader page.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.UI behavior: Numeric setting or fixed policy in Studio; warn when additional matches are suppressed.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Preview behavior: Preview shows which overlays win by priority.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Runtime output: Max N exact reviewed overlays after base article.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Hard stop: Do not merge overflow into a generated summary.

contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Requirement: Fallback hook can contain at most one contextual overlay.
Studio must surface why an overlay was suppressed.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.UI behavior: Read-only diagnostic: exact-aspect duplicate / exact-event article owns mechanism / parent toggle OFF / limit / no eligible fallback text.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Preview behavior: Suppressed block is visibly crossed out or listed under `Not rendering`.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Hard stop: Runtime cannot silently paraphrase a suppressed overlay into another section.

contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Requirement: Every overlay editor card shows source provenance.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.UI behavior: Source is visible and linked in Content Studio.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Preview behavior: Preview badge indicates exact phrase reuse vs source-led synthesis.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Hard stop: Overlay without provenance cannot be promoted to reviewed/serving status.

contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Requirement: OverlayBody and FallbackHookOverlay must be editable through the standard Content Studio versioned draft workflow.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.UI behavior: Editor can change copy fields but trigger predicate remains read-only in ordinary content editing.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Preview behavior: Preview shows draft overlay in full-page position and fallback ON/OFF states.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Runtime output: Approved overlay version may serve only when trigger predicate resolves.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Hard stop: Editing copy must never alter OverlayKey or subject/context trigger facts.

contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Requirement: Overlay edits must preserve immutable source baseline, version history, source URLs, phrase anchors, governance, and prior serving version.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Preview behavior: Studio can compare draft to approved/source baseline.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Runtime output: Serving pointer changes only to owner-approved version.
contentStudioOverlayIntegration.Hard stop: No in-place overwrite of owner/source-approved baseline.
